_meta.derivation: The bundle is HY-V1's issue (pair id, ML-DSA-65 SPKI) under the classical release. The pair id is not the classical catalog id, so the installed-spec key rule does not apply (P:892-899, owner decision on EA-31): row 5.1 is available only when row 7.1's alg is catalog-supported (P:1472), and key format, fingerprint, signature and possession checks are not evaluated. No row fails; the first unperformable is row 7.1 (P:1477): ALG_UNKNOWN, before 8.3's SPEC_UNKNOWN. An examiner holding the wrong installation is told 'cannot evaluate', not 'invalid'.
